scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: LGICUS01 moves ' NO COMMAREA RECEIVED' to EM-VARIABLE, WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG (TD CSMT and TS GENAERRS), IF EIBCALEN > 0 is false, then ABEND LGCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 60 < WS-REQUIRED-CA-LEN 90 (WS-CUSTOMER-LEN 72 + 18): CA-RETURN-CODE '98', RETURN before the LINK

scenarios.name: prefilled-commarea-overwritten
scenarios.why: CA-CUSTOMER-REQUEST arrives full of junk: the nine SELECTed fields are replaced, CA-NUM-POLICIES ('123') and CA-POLICY-DATA are left as they came

scenarios.name: not-found-keeps-prefill
scenarios.why: +100 with a filled COMMAREA: '01' and every customer byte unchanged

notes: Generated-row sibling (#4507) of genapp-lgicus01: GenApp's inquire-customer front end (LGICUS01, LINKed with the 32500-byte LGCMAREA COMMAREA) LINKs LGICDB01 in the same task (LGSTSQ too) on the ten CUSTOMER rows (numbers 1..10) of genapp-lgicdb01-generated, generated from base/cntl/db2cre.jcl (CHAR / DATE boundary values, short values, blanks; seed 4507), not GenApp's INSERTs. The nine nullable columns LGICDB01 SELECTs INTO with no indicator are generated NOT NULL (a NULL would answer SQLCODE -305 and take the '90' path), as in genapp-lgicdb01-generated. The 16 generated requests draw CA-CUSTOMER-NUM from the generated numbers, a quarter of the time a number the rows do not hold (+100, '01'), the request id varied (never tested). Stated: no-commarea (EIBCALEN 0: LGSTSQ, ABEND LGCA), short-commarea (EIBCALEN 60: '98'), and the two prefilled-COMMAREA scenarios (the SELECT's replacement of the bytes, and not-found keeping them). The injected -913 / -811 on the SELECT stay genapp-lgicdb01's. See genapp-lgicus01 for the short-commarea note (MOVE '00' to CA-NUM-POLICIES precedes the check) and the dead IF EIBCALEN > 0.
